text:
Anna (CSM): heads up — noticed a cluster of mid-market accounts with a sharp health_score drop yesterday, looks like onboarding friction + usage dip. can we do a fast drift scrub and assemble a save play? :eyes:
Mike (Support): which signal are we prioritizing? low usage, errors, or outreach failures?
Anna (CSM): priority = usage drop >20% over 7d AND no enablement session in 30d. renewal within 90d gets top priority.
Sam (SuccessOps): I can run a query now and export the top 25. quick SQL I use:```sql
SELECT account_id, health_score, health_delta_7d, last_enablement_date, days_to_renewal
FROM account_health_v2
WHERE health_delta_7d <= -20 AND last_enablement_date < now() - interval '30 days'
ORDER BY health_delta_7d ASC
LIMIT 25;
```
Lee (Enablement): sweet — if you drop the list here I can draft a 30/60/90 micro-training offer we can send. keep it 20-25 seats per cohort, 1-hour workshop + tailored checklist.
Tina (AM): add me on accounts with renewal <=60d. I’ll propose a tailored discount + success SLA during the call.
Mike (Support): I’ll do triage on any accounts with >3 error alerts in logs. can we tag those so I know which need engineer pairing?
Anna (CSM): plan for each account: 1) outreach email + calendar offer (Lee) 2) rapid troubleshooting (Mike) 3) downgrade-path mapped if they want to reduce spend (Tina) 4) feedback capture + NPS follow-up (Sam).
Sam (SuccessOps): downgrade-path template: - current_plan -> reduced_feature_set mapping - minimum seat/usage thresholds - migration checklist - data/backups note - opt-in re-upgrade coupon (60-day). I’ll paste a JSON-ish snippet for ops to create a task:```
{
  "account": "<id>",
  "action": "downgrade_proposal",
  "fallback_offer": "50% credits or 2-week free extender",
  "owner": "Tina (AM)"
}
```
RetentionBot: automated note: 7 accounts flagged, avg health_delta -27%, 3 accounts renewal <45d.
Tina (AM): for downgrade offers, prefer structured downgrade + time-limited re-upgrade credits. avoids churn while keeping upgrade path.
Lee (Enablement): quick outreach copy draft (short):
"Hi <FirstName>, noticed your team hit some friction with X. quick 30-min workshop and checklist might help — free for your team this month. Want a slot?"
Anna (CSM): love it. Sam — can you add a column for "last_feedback" and "top_issue" in the export? want to capture qualitative reasons.
Sam (SuccessOps): done. will push CSV to #cs-ops-drop with <link> in 10m.
Mike (Support): I’ll start a support-runbook for the top 3 recurring errors — will link runbook in the CSV.
Tina (AM): I’ll schedule 1:1s for high-risk renewals after Lee’s workshop outreach; if they ask about cost we offer downgrade + 60-day credit.
Anna (CSM): assign owners and deadlines: outreach by EOD, enablement sessions scheduled within 7d, downgrade proposals sent within 48h of request. who is owning the EOD outreach?
Lee (Enablement): I can own the outreach template + first wave (10 accounts).
Sam (SuccessOps): I’ll own the export + feedback aggregation and tag tasks in CRM.
Mike (Support): I’ll own the triage and engineer pairing.
Tina (AM): I’ll own pricing/downgrade proposals and final handoff.
Anna (CSM): perfect — please react with :white_check_mark: when you’ve completed your item. I’ll follow up tomorrow 10am PT for status.
Lee (Enablement): :white_check_mark: drafting outreach now.
Sam (SuccessOps): :white_check_mark: exporting and tagging.
Mike (Support): :white_check_mark: starting triage.
Tina (AM): :white_check_mark: prepping downgrade template.
Anna (CSM): thanks team — capture any customer quotes in the CSV so we can feed product for quick wins. if anyone hits a blocker tag me directly. :pray:
